refnamediv.refpurpose: Implements the core of the MUSIC (Multiple Signal Classification) algorithm.

listitem.para: A structure containing the following fields:
Boolean flag indicating whether `x` is a correlation matrix.
Length of the window for signal segmentation.
Number of overlapping samples between consecutive windows.
Window function to apply to each segment.
Boolean flag indicating whether a window function is specified.
Signal subspace dimension and optional threshold for eigenvalue selection.
A structure containing the following fields:
Eigenvectors corresponding to the signal subspace.
Eigenvectors corresponding to the noise subspace.
Effective dimension of the signal subspace.
A string containing error messages, if any.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `musicBase` function implements the core of the MUSIC algorithm, which is used for spectral estimation and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. It computes the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the correlation matrix (or signal matrix) and separates them into signal and noise subspaces. The effective dimension of the signal subspace is determined based on the input parameters.
